# How To Using Templates

## 🗂️ Repository

[https://github.com/ljcoder2015/obsidian-sheet-plus-template](https://github.com/ljcoder2015/obsidian-sheet-plus-template)

## 📥 Using Templates

1. Browse this repository and choose a template you need
2. Download the entire template folder
3. Drag the folder into your Obsidian vault (any location is fine)
4. Open Obsidian and start using the template in **Sheet Plus**

> 💡 Tip: You may want to keep all templates under a dedicated folder such as `Templates/SheetPlus/`.

---

## 📂 Template Categories

Templates are organized following widely used **Excel template conventions**, making them easy to understand and discover.

### 📊 finance

Financial templates for managing money, budgets, and financial records.
Typical use cases: Budget, Expense Tracker, Invoice, Investment Tracker

---

### 📁 project-management

Templates for planning, tracking, and managing projects from start to finish.
Typical use cases: Project Plan, Task List, Gantt Chart, Milestones

---

### 📅 calendar

Calendar and scheduling templates for organizing time and events.
Typical use cases: Weekly Calendar, Monthly Calendar, Schedules

---

### 🧾 tracking

Tracking templates for monitoring progress, status, and performance.
Typical use cases: KPI Tracker, Progress Tracker, Time Tracking

---

### 🧑‍💼 business

Business-oriented templates for operations, sales, and data management.
Typical use cases: Sales Tracker, CRM, Inventory, Forecasting

---

### 🧠 personal

Personal templates for daily life organization and self-management.
Typical use cases: Personal Budget, Habit Tracker, Life Planner

---

### 📖 education

Templates designed for learning, studying, and academic planning.
Typical use cases: Study Plan, Course Tracker, Grade Tracker

---

### 🎯 goals

Goal-setting and planning templates for short-term and long-term objectives.
Typical use cases: Goal Tracker, OKR, Annual Planning

---

## 🗂️ Repository Structure

```text
obsidian-sheet-plus-template/
├── finance/
├── project-management/
├── calendar/
├── tracking/
├── business/
├── personal/
├── education/
└── goals/
```

Each category contains one or more template folders.

---

## 📁 Template Structure

Each template must follow this structure:

```text
TemplateName/
├── template.md   # Main Sheet Plus template file
├── cover.png     # Template preview image
├── readme.md     # Template documentation
└── images/       # Images used in readme.md
```

---

## 📝 File Description

### `template.md`

The core Sheet Plus template file.
This file is used directly inside Obsidian.

### `cover.png`

A preview image showing the template layout and intended use case.

### `readme.md`

Documentation explaining:

* What the template is for
* How to use it
* Example screenshots and notes

### `images/`

Stores images referenced in `readme.md`.

---

## 🤝 Contributing Templates

Community contributions are welcome 🎉
If you have created a useful Sheet Plus template, feel free to share it.

### How to Contribute

1. Fork this repository
2. Create a new branch

   * **The branch name must be your template name**
3. Choose an existing category (or create a new one if necessary)
4. Add your template following the required structure
5. Submit a Pull Request with a short description of your template

---

## ✅ Contribution Guidelines

* Templates should work with the **latest version of Obsidian Sheet Plus**
* Do not include personal or sensitive data
* Keep file and folder names clear and consistent
* Prefer existing categories whenever possible

---

## 📌 Naming Conventions

* Use lowercase letters for folders
* Use nouns or noun phrases (Excel-style)
* Hyphens are allowed for multi-word categories
* Avoid verbs such as `manage`, `track`, `handle`

---
